URL Parser

Deconstruct any URL into protocol, host, port, path, query parameters, hash and more.

Passwords are masked. Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is sent anywhere.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste any absolute URL into the box.
  2. Every part is extracted instantly into a table.
  3. Query parameters are listed one per line, decoded.
  4. Passwords are masked automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the URL I paste sent anywhere?

No. Everything runs locally in your browser — the URL is never sent to any server, and passwords are masked in the output.

Why do I get an “invalid URL” error?

The URL constructor requires an absolute URL with a scheme. Add https:// (or the right scheme) and try again.

Are query parameters decoded?

Yes — searchParams decodes percent-encoding for you, and each parameter is listed on its own line.
